g.text: [next interval is a break and autoStartBreaks is true]
[next interval is work and autoStartWork is true]
A long break replaces a short break after every
N completed work intervals (N is configurable).
The interval sequence is stored on the aggregate.
The backend scheduler invokes this use case directly
when an interval is due. There is no public REST route.
WebSocket forwarding is best-effort; clients reconcile from REST snapshots.
